meta.scope: Current repository data, all complete set-* directories
meta.length_counting: Characters exclude whitespace and markup; words are whitespace-delimited after markup removal. File paths and metadata are excluded.
meta.near_duplicate_method: Within each question number, normalized substantive content compared by character-trigram Jaccard at >=0.820 with a minimum 0.75 length ratio; generic prompt excluded; exact duplicates excluded; media compared by content hash.
meta.visual_line_method: Estimate for Q11-Q16 using explicit line breaks plus weighted glyph widths at approximately 48 Korean glyph units, based on current desktop card/stem CSS. This is approximate, not browser pixel measurement.
